facts.en: Earned a Bachelor of Engineering in electronic engineering at Fictional Copperwave University in 2015.
facts.zh: 2015 年在虚构铜波大学获得电子工程工学学士学位。

facts.en: Paid electronics test assistant at Fictional Ripplecircuit Works from 2015-08 to 2018-06.
facts.zh: 2015-08 至 2018-06 在虚构涟漪电路工厂任有薪电子测试助理。

facts.en: There, performed scripted bench checks on low-voltage training boards and documented results for an engineer.
facts.zh: 在该工厂依照脚本对低压培训板进行台架检查，并为工程师记录结果。

facts.en: Paid robotics workshop instructor at Fictional Lanternbot Learning from 2018-09 to 2023-12.
facts.zh: 2018-09 至 2023-12 在虚构灯机器人学习中心任有薪机器人工作坊讲师。

facts.en: Paid programme coordinator at the same centre from 2024-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-01 至 2026-08 在同一中心任有薪项目协调员。

facts.en: Plans workshop schedules and adapts approved beginner lessons using block-based coding and small wheeled kits.
facts.zh: 规划工作坊日程，并使用积木式编程及小型轮式套件调整获批入门课程。

facts.en: Delivers supervised group activities and checks kit condition before sessions.
facts.zh: 开展受监督的团体活动，并在活动前检查套件状态。

facts.en: Coordinates 4 session instructors’ timetables; the centre manager handles contracts and formal performance reviews.
facts.zh: 协调 4 名活动讲师的时间表；中心经理处理合同及正式绩效评审。

facts.en: Led timetable and kit planning for a 2025-07 holiday programme.
facts.zh: 牵头为 2025-07 假期项目制定时间表及套件计划。

facts.en: The programme delivered 24 sessions with 216 attendance entries representing 92 distinct learners.
facts.zh: 该项目开展 24 场活动，记录 216 人次出席，代表 92 名不同学习者。

facts.en: An end-of-programme survey received 38 responses; 34 respondents said the activities were enjoyable.
facts.zh: 项目结束问卷收到 38 份回答；34 名回答者表示活动有趣。

facts.en: The survey measured reported enjoyment rather than verified coding proficiency or long-term learning gains.
facts.zh: 该问卷衡量自报的趣味感受，而非经验证的编程熟练度或长期学习提升。

facts.en: Personally redesigned the kit checkout sheet and wrote a reusable setup checklist for the programme.
facts.zh: 个人为该项目重新设计套件领用表，并编写可复用的布置核对表。

facts.en: Uses block-based coding, kit troubleshooting guides, spreadsheets and shared teaching calendars.
facts.zh: 使用积木式编程、套件故障排查指南、电子表格及共享教学日历。

facts.en: Completed the centre’s internal safeguarding-reporting refresher in 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2025-03 完成中心内部人员保护问题上报复训。

facts.en: Reports safeguarding concerns to the designated lead and does not investigate them independently.
facts.zh: 向指定负责人报告人员保护问题，不独立调查。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Geargarden Community Fair in 2022, helping visitors assemble paper mechanical toys.
facts.zh: 2022 年在虚构齿轮园社区集市做志愿者，协助访客组装纸机械玩具。

facts.en: Made a personal battery-powered cardboard rover in 2021 for leisure demonstrations, not commercial deployment.
facts.zh: 2021 年制作个人电池驱动纸板小车，用于休闲演示，而非商业部署。

facts.en: Enjoys creating logic puzzles and decorating miniature cardboard houses.
facts.zh: 爱好创作逻辑谜题及装饰微型纸板房屋。

facts.en: Maintains kit-repair requests and updates instructors when a planned activity needs approved substitution.
facts.zh: 维护套件维修请求，并在计划活动需要获批替代方案时通知讲师。
